install.note: CLI coding agent by Kilo, forked from OpenCode. The binary is `kilo` (curl installs to ~/.kilo/bin and updates PATH; restart the shell or source the rc file before verifying). Windows: use npm or the GitHub Releases binary. Do NOT install `opencode-ai` — Kilo Code is a separate product with its own npm package `@kilocode/cli`.

blocked_regions.zh-CN: kilo.ai is reachable in mainland China, but the curl installer downloads the binary from GitHub Releases, which is unreliable there. If the curl install stalls or fails, use npm instead: `npm install -g @kilocode/cli --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com`.

first_run.description: On first launch `kilo` opens a TUI. To use your own provider, add an OpenAI-compatible provider block in the config file, or run /connect and pick a provider. OpenRouter, Anthropic, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint are supported.
